proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.grantedSpellOptionRestriction
proposed_widenings.justification: The current spell-grant override surface can change DC, area, targeting, and duration, but it cannot narrow a granted spell to only a subset of its allowed cast-time options. The wand's Command cast is restricted to two command words, so unrestricted grant_spell_access would mis-state the item.

notes: Authored and traced the honest subset only: Fear at fixed DC 15 with a 60-foot cone override. The restricted Command grant is intentionally omitted until the grant surface can encode spell-option narrowing.
